title: Russian Pudding
description: A rich and creamy dessert inspired by Russian cuisine, made with pudding and milk.
instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine pudding, milk, sugar, and vanilla.
2. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
3. Remove from heat and stir in the egg.
4. Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
5. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until chilled.
6. Serve cold, garnished with a sprinkle of sugar if desired.
